title: Mode 3: MemorySandboxService, harness, 6 E2E scenarios
description:
Implement Mode 3 E2E core from docs/plans/14-mode3-e2e.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (test suite structure), §4 (6 scenarios), §7 (testing strategy — MemorySandboxService)

Key deliverables:
- MemorySandboxService: in-memory fake sandbox implementing full SandboxHostService contract (state machine, file maps per session, snapshot deep-copy, tier routing via ClassifyTool, concurrent-safe)
- RemoteEnv harness: RPC client + fake host bootstrapping
- SessionLifecycle harness: create/pause/resume/destroy helpers
- SnapshotAssertion harness: snapshot + remote-dispatch assertions
- 6 E2E scenario tests in e2etests/mode3/:
  - S1: Happy-path remote workflow (RPC dispatch, multi-turn)
  - S2: Tier routing with snapshot metadata (Tier 1+2 mix)
  - S3: Rollback correctness (state restoration)
  - S4: Pause/resume continuity (identity + workspace)
  - S5: Session recovery/destroy semantics
  - S6: Event stream remote visibility (ordered milestones)
- Unit tests for MemorySandboxService, all harness components

AC: Mode 3 happy path completes, full lifecycle works, snapshots restore correctly, both tiers succeed remotely, events are ordered, no MCP in Mode 3.
